title: Radha Ka Sangam
desc: Radha and Govinda are in love with each other and get married. Post the wedding, their life goes awry when Govinda is arrested, leaving Radha to tackle problems all alone.

title: Dabangg 3
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a corrupt police officer, leads a happy life with his wife and family. However, when his past enemy returns to wreak havoc, he must protect his loved ones from harm.

title: Hindustan Ki Kasam
desc: Two twin brothers, separated at birth, grow up as a Hindu in India and a Muslim in Pakistan. However, fate reunites them on opposite sides of the battlefield.

title: Aitraaz
desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baraat
desc: A woman's desperate plea for justice falls on deaf ears as she's forced against her will to marry the man who assaulted her.
